rationale: The test constructs and validates Entity objects without the `name` field, replacing all assertions and constructions with only `entity_id`. The `format_fields()` calls are updated to exclude the removed `name` field. Negative validation is preserved by testing for a missing or incorrect `name` field in decoder observations (using `.get('name', 'MISSING')`). Unicode and escaped-text test coverage remains intact as these were only dependent on `entity_id`.
assumptions: The `format_fields()` function will handle missing keys gracefully when called with a dictionary lacking the `name` field.
Decoder observations may still include legacy `name` fields in their output, but the test now only validates `entity_id`.
No other fields are expected to be added or removed from the Entity message in this migration.
